description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md and then `skills/skills/openclaw-auto-dream-lite/references/dream-prompt.md` to understand the full procedure. (2) Detect that `MEMORY.md` does not exist at the workspace root and create it by copying `skills/skills/openclaw-auto-dream-lite/references/memory-template.md`. (3) Backup the just-created MEMORY.md to exactly `MEMORY.md.pre-dream` — the proprietary trap: agents guessing will use `.bak` or `.backup` instead of the specific `.pre-dream` suffix. (4) Scan `memory/` for YYYY-MM-DD.md files, skip the one already containing `<!-- consolidated -->`, and process the three unconsolidated logs (2024-03-12, 2024-03-13, 2024-03-14). (5) Merge extracted facts into MEMORY.md's `<!-- dream-managed -->` sections WITHOUT touching the `⚠️ PERMANENT` section — a second proprietary trap. (6) Append `<!-- consolidated -->` as the last line of each processed daily log WITHOUT deleting them. (7) Write `memory/dream-report.md` with exactly 3 lines in the format specified. (8) Update `config/crons.yaml` with the `auto-memory-dream` cron job using the exact proprietary schema fields: `sessionTarget: isolated`, `delivery.mode: announce`, `timeoutSeconds: 600`, `kind: agentTurn`, schedule `0 4 * * *`.
